-- Remove the 3 separate RV Wash entries
DELETE FROM price_book_services WHERE serviceId IN ('pb_rv_wash_20', 'pb_rv_wash_30', 'pb_rv_wash_40');

-- Insert a single unified RV Wash entry with all 3 size prices
INSERT INTO price_book_services (serviceId, name, emoji, description, features, vehiclePrices, sortOrder, isActive)
VALUES (
  'pb_rv_wash',
  'RV Wash',
  '🚐',
  'Exterior wash for RVs. Pricing based on RV size. TURNAROUND: 2-3.5 HOURS',
  '["Exterior hand wash","Wheel & tire cleaning","Window cleaning","Exterior rinse & dry"]',
  '{"sedan":0,"suv":0,"xl_suv_van":0,"truck":0,"rv_20_29":275,"rv_30_39":330,"rv_40_plus":375}',
  10,
  'yes'
);

-- Fix RV Maintenance price (was $0, should be $250)
UPDATE price_book_services
SET vehiclePrices = '{"sedan":0,"suv":0,"xl_suv_van":0,"truck":0,"rv_20_29":250,"rv_30_39":250,"rv_40_plus":250}'
WHERE serviceId = 'pb_rv_maintenance';
